subject: Annual prepay statement + withdrawal forecast
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@acme-corp.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Finance Ops <billing@acme-corp.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Annual prepay statement and planned withdrawals for FY27

Hi Mateo,

As we ramp into Q2, Finance asked me to get a clear statement of our committed prepay balance and a withdrawal forecast for the next 12 months. We have the signed commitment in place (RW-ACME-2027-01) and need two things to close our internal booking:

- A one-page statement showing current prepay balance, invoices issued to date, and remaining committed dollar amount.
- A monthly withdrawal forecast for the remaining commitment (we expect front-loaded usage on analytics workloads through July).

Also, can you confirm the VAT handling for EU-originated usage? We show some invoices hitting EU VAT codes last year and need an explicit mapping for our tax team.

Can you send the statement and a simple worksheet we can drop into our ledger? Ideally by next Thursday (Apr 8). If it helps, we can schedule a quick 20-min call to walk the spreadsheet.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Elena Morales
Head of Cloud Economics, Acme Analytics
elena@acme-corp.com

[attachment: previous-invoice-ACME-202703.pdf (pdf)]

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Annual prepay statement and planned withdrawals for FY27

Hi Elena — thanks for laying this out.

We're on it. Quick notes and plan:

1) Deliverables by Thu Apr 8:
   - one-page statement (PDF) with committed amount, invoices posted, and remaining balance
   - withdrawal forecast worksheet (XLSX) with monthly rows and two scenarios: baseline and front-loaded

2) VAT mapping: Monica will own the EU VAT mapping; we'll include the VAT treatment on each historical invoice line and a short note on whether the charge is zero-rated or standard-rate for Acme's jurisdictions.

3) Call: happy to do 20 minutes — propose Tue Apr 6 10:00 AM PT. If that doesn't work, suggest Wed Apr 7 2:00 PM PT.

I attached a draft worksheet and a brief internal checklist we use for accounting import. If you want different column names for your ERP, tell us and we'll adapt.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Account Executive — Strategic Customers
Redwood Inference
mateo_alvarez@redwood.com

Attachments: annual-prepay-statement-Q2-2027.pdf (draft), prepay-withdrawal-forecast-worksheet.xlsx (draft)

Thanks Mateo — 10:00 AM PT today works. I'll ask our controller (copied on calendar invite) to join for a couple minutes at the start to confirm VAT expectations.

A couple of quick clarifications before the call:
- Can the statement show the invoice date and the accounting period separately? Our ERP uses the accounting period for recognition.
- For the forecast worksheet: please include a separate column for "expected tokens/month" and a row for any scheduled model upgrades that might change unit pricing.

Also, we need the signed invoice sample in the same packet so our AP team can see numbering and remit instructions.

See you in 20.

Elena

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 9 Apr 2027 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Final: Prepay statement + agreed withdrawal schedule (RW-ACME-2027-01)

Elena / team —

Thanks for the call earlier this week. Per agreement: attached are the finalized files. Summary below for your records and for Acme AP: 

Summary (key deliverables)
- Final one-page prepay statement (annual-prepay-statement-Q2-2027.pdf) — includes
  • Original committed amount: $1,200,000
  • Invoices issued to date: $320,000
  • Remaining committed balance: $880,000
  • Invoice numbering sample and remit instructions included in appendix

- Withdrawal forecast workbook (prepay-withdrawal-forecast-worksheet.xlsx) — two scenarios provided:
  • Baseline (even cadence): monthly withdrawals of $73,333 for 12 months
  • Front-loaded (expected): Apr–Jul higher consumption with monthly withdrawals of [120k, 110k, 90k, 80k], then graded down for remainder; a tokens/month column is included and the sheet accounts for a planned model upgrade in July that adjusts unit price by +6%

VAT and tax handling
- EU VAT mapping: charges invoiced to EU jurisdictions are annotated with the invoice-level VAT code. For Acme (EU entity), we mark those invoices as reverse-charge where applicable and include a VAT-reconciliation tab in the workbook with the evidence needed for your tax team (supplier VAT id, service description, invoice PDF reference).

Next operational steps (requested from Acme)
1) Confirm preferred withdrawal scenario (baseline or front-loaded) by Apr 12 so we can time invoice issuance.
2) Provide AP remit contact and preferred payment method (wire vs. ACH). If wire, we will add the beneficiary instructions to the next invoice PDF.
3) If you require a different column naming convention for ingestion, send a sample CSV import file and we'll adapt the worksheet.

Attachments: annual-prepay-statement-Q2-2027.pdf, prepay-withdrawal-forecast-worksheet.xlsx

Thanks — let us know if you want us to route invoices to a different departmental contact.

Best regards,
Monica Patel
